The English translation leaves the headword untranslated.

flags.why: Cứ liệu belongs to formal or academic usage and needs a register warning.
The expression is coarse and needs a vulgar warning beyond informal ([reference](https://ykhoa.org/chia-se-ngoay-mui-gi-mui/)).
Cừu hận means hatred or enmity, not a person who is an enemy ([reference](https://hvdic.thivien.net/hv/cừu%20hận)).
The example defines a nonagon instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Em vẽ một hình cửu giác vào vở. = I drew a nonagon in my notebook.
